summary: Assess HR AI use cases, map workflows, and plan responsible automation with practical exercises. Explore the 5-day course and outline.
lede: AI and automation in HR help HR operations, talent acquisition, and people analytics professionals assess responsible use cases and plan controlled workflow improvements. You’ll practise mapping processes, checking HR data quality, documenting human review, and using Excel to analyse HR metrics. Applied exercises produce risk records, workflow maps, and a staged roadmap, with an overview of the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and ISO/IEC 42001.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who assess, operate, govern, or report on AI and automation use in HR workflows.
modules: NIST AI Risk Management for HR
prerequisites: Working knowledge of HR processes and routine spreadsheet use is recommended. No coding or programming is required; bring an Excel-enabled laptop for the workbook-based exercises.
